issues.description: Code-style rule 7 requires every shell script to start with `set -euo pipefail`; the script only enables `set -u`. The harness intentionally runs commands that are expected to fail (exit-code assertions, `retry ... -- false`), so `set -e` would abort legitimate checks, but the deviation is not documented anywhere in the file. Non-blocking code-style deviation; does not affect test correctness (verified: the script emits exactly 28 TAP lines and exits 1 when a check fails).
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a comment at the top documenting the intentional deviation (test harness must observe non-zero exit codes and /bin/sh lacks pipefail), or restructure with `set -eu` plus explicit `|| true`/`if` guards on the expected-failure invocations as code-style rule 10 allows.

issues.description: The evidence table cites `1.0.6/reports/w3-local-ci.log` (pr-body.md:95) and `1.0.6/reports/conan-verify-report.md` (pr-body.md:96), and test-report.md:152 also cites `reports/conan-verify-report.md`, but neither file is part of the submission (absent from changed_files/file_contents). Review rule 19 even forbids committing `*.log`, so the w3-local-ci.log citation can never be backed by a committed file. The primary claims themselves (upstream 0 cases, 28/28 new assertions) are internally consistent and independently verified; this is a citation/completeness gap only, non-blocking.
issues.fix_suggestion: Point the evidence rows at the committed `reports/test-report.md` and `test_package/MANIFEST.yml`; either commit the conan-verify summary as a .md under reports/ or remove/adjust both conan-verify-report.md references.

issues.description: `patch_generation.source_orig_dir` (line 34) and `source_work_dir` (line 35) embed the author's local absolute build paths `/storage/Users/currentUser/work/kasumizawa-miyuu/tmp/builds/retry-1.0.6.orig` and `.../retry-1.0.6.work`. No embedded rule blocks this, but committing local environment paths is unnecessary exposure and non-reproducible metadata. Non-blocking.
issues.fix_suggestion: Drop the two absolute path fields (keep source_orig_hash / source_work_hash / patches_count) or replace them with generic relative names.

issues.description: Section comments misnumber the checks after the newly added stdin block: line 145 `# 19-20. --until=fail stops at the first failing attempt` actually covers emitted TAP checks 20-21; line 151 `# 21. --while=fail ...` is check 22 (the following section is already labelled 23-24). The emitted plan is 1..28 and MANIFEST.yml assertion_count is 28 (verified statically and by executing the script with a stub binary: exactly 28 TAP lines), so this is documentation-only. Non-blocking.
issues.fix_suggestion: Renumber the two section comments to `# 20-21.` and `# 22.` so the internal ordinals match the emitted TAP lines.

summary: Independent W4 pre-PR re-audit of retry 1.0.6 (archives/r/retry/): PASS, zero P0/P1. Deception checks (R34/R9/R8/R19/R40/R52) are clean: test_package/test() really runs the installed CLI via sh test_retry.sh, and the script executes the packaged binary (command -v retry, -v, --help and 22 functional invocations) with passed/failed counters and exit 1 on any failure - verified by running the script with a stub retry: exactly 28 TAP lines are emitted, plan 1..28, exit 1. The round-1 P3 is fixed: the stdin probe now fails on the first attempt, succeeds on the second, writes both attempts' stdin to files, and checks 18/19 compare each captured file against the full piped payload (alpha/bravo), so replay is genuinely exercised; MANIFEST.yml/notes.md/test-report.md/pr-body.md/manifest.yaml all consistently describe this and all assert 28 (no stale 27, no placeholder text). R51 inventory claims were independently verified against the official tarball downloaded from GitHub: 28 files, no tests//test-named files, Makefile.am only bin_PROGRAMS = retry (0 TESTS/check_PROGRAMS/check-local), configure enable.*test = 0. R39/sha256: conandata.yml holds a single official HTTPS GitHub release URL with no mirror/file:// entry; sha256 c208baf759134da27012042ccc30df7d995ed038d7d5602db7dbda3becb34827 matches both the GitHub API asset digest and the actual downloaded tarball (340567 bytes). All three patches apply cleanly to that tarball via git apply --check, are pure POSIX portability fixes (config.guess HarmonyOS branch, config.sub linux-ohos tokens, configure umask 077->022) with no __OHOS__/replace()/stub or compiler-env injection, and no prebuilt binaries or manual-packaging bypass exist. R32/R33/R37/R38 satisfied: validate() uses ('Linux','OHOS'), no hardcoded toolchain, upstream version 1.0.6, software-level commands.json with type=tool and ref retry/1.0.6. W2 atomicity holds: all 15 changed files are under archives/r/retry/ (no framework files, no other packages); no .ci-result.json, secrets, C:\Users paths, BOM, CRLF or placeholder text; all files end with a single LF. Non-blocking notes only: test_retry.sh uses set -u without -e/-o pipefail (P2, code-style 7); pr-body/test-report cite reports/w3-local-ci.log and reports/conan-verify-report.md which are not in the submission (P3); version manifest embeds local absolute build paths (P3); two section comments in test_retry.sh are off by one after the stdin-test insertion (P3).
